caption: The drawing features a spinning wheel depicted within a rectangular frame centered on a plain, light beige background. The spinning wheel itself is rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, capturing the wood texture and various turned elements of its construction. The wheel has multiple spokes and is connected by a bluish belt to the smaller components of the apparatus. The frame of the spinning wheel includes several vertical and diagonal supports, all in matching wood tones. Near the lower center of the page but outside the main frame, there is a smaller square containing a similarly colored, quick sketch of part of the spinning wheel, mainly the spindle, with a bit of gray shading, and next to it is the name "EUGENE LA FORET" written in plain, uppercase letters. The composition is orderly, placing the spinning wheel prominently in the middle and the signature area neatly below.
title: Spinning Wheel
